references.context: The Castle ramp is the long left ramp; each completed shot counts as a Loop. The Coffin ramp is the shorter upper-right ramp. Learn how both return before committing to the stack.
references.label: Castle ramp (left ramp)
references.description: The entrance is above the Asylum on the upper-left. The long ramp loops around the back and returns to the right inlane.
